free_tier_limits.correction: A 15-day Standard-plan trial is available. After a trial or subscription ends, the restricted Free plan cannot post jobs or interact with candidates and can only view existing candidate data.

rate_limits.correction: 10 requests per 10 seconds; exceeding the limit returns HTTP 429.

description.correction: Workable is an ATS with a REST API for retrieving jobs and hiring-workflow data and for creating, updating, and moving candidates. Its documented native job endpoints retrieve job postings; the current official documentation does not show native endpoints for creating or updating job postings.

notes: The current API is SPI v3 under each account subdomain. It uses an API key/token in the Authorization: Bearer header, limits requests to 10 per 10 seconds, and does not support CORS. Workable documents both a 15-day trial and a restricted Free plan.
